name: CASINO, GUICH.INH. EO1,53
summary: CASINO, GUICH.INH. EO1,53 is a French retail group operating a variety of store formats, including hypermarkets, supermarkets, convenience stores, and discount stores. The company has a significant presence in France and Latin America, offering a wide range of food and non-food products. Casino, Guichard-Perrachon is headquartered in Saint-Étienne, France, and focuses on adapting its retail formats to local markets.
